explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 groups by CLASS and checks the count of rows in each group, while Q2 groups by CLASS and checks the count of the constant value 2 in each group. Since the count of a constant value is always the number of rows in the group, Q2 will always return the same results as Q1 if the count of rows is >= 5. However, if the count of rows is < 5, Q2 will return an empty result set, while Q1 will return the CLASS with a count of rows >= 5.
